header: The key points a reader should remember
lead: Two to six lines in a box, for the top of a long report or the end of a guide.

points.title: Each point is one line.
points.text: An explanation under it is optional and uses smaller text.

points.title: No headings, so the page outline stays short.
points.text: Six one-line headings would fill the outline with entries that lead nowhere.

points.title: The block’s icon marks every point.
points.text: A point can pick an icon of its own. Without any icon, each point gets a plain dot.

points.title: Compact mode tightens the box.
points.text: Less padding, for a narrow column or the end of a long page.
